status: declared by the pull request that closes #375; the bar is Eleonora's replacement ruling of 7 October 2026 on #375 (the success bar is replaced); the cut-offs and tier limits were fixed before any candidate was scored, but the week-ahead combiner was changed from independence to the maximum after the benchmark rows' calibration was seen under the first (see the pull request); the other choices that ruling leaves open (what a false alarm is, how the lead-at-least readings combine horizons, the scheduled risk dates, how calibration by regime is tested, the baseline rows' cut-offs, the bootstrap block length, the usefulness preference) are listed in that pull request for her review; amended by the pull request that closes #407: the flag cut-off is no longer declared per candidate (the fixed 0.2 placeholder) but chosen at each refit and horizon from that refit's training window alone by cutoff_rule, calibration by regime in tier 3 is tested only in regimes with a pressure day, and a pass within the scarce regime is reported beside the pass rule; the tiers' limits, the pass rule and the confirmation look are unchanged; the candidates of the onset classifier (#409) are added, declared in metadata/onset_classifier.json before any was scored; the candidates of the risk-date severity model (#428) are added, declared in metadata/risk_date_severity.json before any was scored; the candidates of track F (#425), the hierarchical logistic with Fed repo operation and Standing Repo Facility inputs, are added, declared before any was scored; the candidates of the same-day reading of Fed repo operation availability (#442), the two track-F candidates with their inputs read at 16:00 on the operation date instead of the next business day, are added, declared before any was scored; the candidate of the same-day nowcast (#445) is added, declared in metadata/nowcast.json before any was scored; the second nowcast candidate (the nowcast substituted for the latest spread) is added by the same pull request, declared in the amendment of metadata/nowcast.json before it was scored; amended by the pull request that closes #446 (tooling only, no candidate, cut-off rule, tier, bar or figure changes): each candidate's declaration is now a file of its own, metadata/pressure_judge/candidates/<name>.json, and this file holds the rest of the declaration. A new candidate is added by adding its file there (and its name to confirmation.candidates if it is to be looked at), never by editing this file, so that pull requests that each add a candidate do not conflict

cutoff_rule.amended_by: the pull request that closes #407, under Eleonora's ruling of 8 October 2026 on #374 (replaces the fixed 0.2 placeholder cut-off)
cutoff_rule.choice: the cut-off with the highest onset recall whose false alarms per onset on the refit's training window are at most the limit; of cut-offs with the same recall, the highest
cutoff_rule.training_window: the forecast's own earlier walk-forward probabilities on the scored days whose outcome was known at the refit's first decision instant (up to the business day before it), from the first scored day; the same for every candidate and benchmark, at each threshold and horizon
